tools.name: extract_contacts
tools.description: Fetch a site's homepage and up to max_pages-1 contact/about pages and return every email, phone (validated, E.164, type), WhatsApp link, social profile, postal address and organisation field found, with provenance per item. Example: url 'noahsarch.tech', max_pages 3, region 'AE'. Response: result wi

tools.name: find_social_profiles
tools.description: Homepage only: Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, Telegram, Snapchat, Pinterest, Threads, GitHub, TripAdvisor, Google Business links plus WhatsApp chat links, with handles. Share buttons are excluded. Example: url 'https://example.com'. Response: result with emails[] (email,

tools.name: extract_contacts_bulk
tools.description: One call for a lead list: each site gets homepage + contact pages (max_pages), results per site plus a summary (sites with email/phone/WhatsApp, failures). Charged per page fetched across all sites. Example: urls ['a.com','b.ae'], max_pages 2, region 'AE'. Response: result with emails[] (email, sour

tools.name: extract_from_html
tools.description: Same parser, no fetching: emails (incl. obfuscated 'name [at] domain [dot] com'), phones, WhatsApp, social links, addresses, schema.org organisation data, and the contact-page links present. Free. Example: html '<a href="mailto:x@y.com">'. Response: result with emails[] (email, source, role), phones

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: GET the URL (robots-respecting, public hosts only) and report status, final URL after redirects, content type, title, declared languages and whether a contact page is linked. Use before a bulk job or to clean a URL list. Example: url 'example.com'. Response: result with emails[] (email, source, role

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_contacts, extract_contacts_bulk, check_url · Private data: extract_contacts, extract_contacts_bulk, extract_from_html, check_url · Public sink: extract_contacts, find_social_profiles, extract_contacts_bulk, extract_from_html, check_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_contacts, extract_contacts_bulk, check_url · Private data: extract_contacts, extract_contacts_bulk, extract_from_html, check_url · Public sink: extract_contacts, find_social_profiles, extract_contacts_bulk, extract_from_html, check_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
